findings.detail: MODULE_GUIDE.md keeps every prose block as an EN/AR pair, and §2.4 'Error handling · Edge cases · Unsupported' is no exception: line 241 is **EN:** and line 249 is **AR:**. This PR added the '(considered and deliberately not planned — D14)' qualifier to the EN line only. The AR line still reads a bare 'لا تحقق بين ملفات' — exactly the unqualified phrasing D14 was written to stop a future reader from treating as an unfinished feature. An Arabic-reading reviewer or roadmap pass gets the pre-D14 text and the reopening that D14 explicitly forbids becomes likely, which defeats the stated purpose of the change. Scoped low, not medium, because the decision is still recorded authoritatively in open-decisions.md; it would be medium if MODULE_GUIDE.md were the only place the scope limit lived.

findings.detail: Not a defect in this diff — D14 scopes itself correctly, saying the phrase it governs is the one 'in the Files Validation section of MODULE_GUIDE.md'. Noting it only because MODULE_GUIDE.md §2.2 'Unsupported features' carries the same words for a different module, so a reader grepping the phrase lands on line 163 first and may assume D14 settled Composite Check's scope too. D14 does not cover it, and the PR is right not to claim otherwise.
